name: How does door frame installation differ in basement remodels compared to upper floors?

mainEntity.name: How does door frame installation differ in basement remodels compared to upper floors?

acceptedAnswer.text: When finishing basement spaces across Parker, Centennial, and the greater Denver area, contractors must account for concrete slab movement and framing height variations. Door frames installed in basement partitions often require treated base plates, moisture barriers against concrete, and custom jamb sizing if ceiling heights are lower due to ductwork or plumbing runs. Because basement framing is often tied into floating walls to accommodate soil expansion, door frames must be secured accurately so that normal slab shifts do not torque the jamb.
acceptedAnswer.description: Basement frames must account for concrete floor moisture, floating wall construction for expansive soils, and custom jamb heights around lower ceiling ductwork.
